projects.title: Event Center, Trnava
projects.description:
Designed by QBC Architects, this event center and restaurant in Trnava, near Topola, balances contemporary hospitality architecture with the authentic character of the Šumadija landscape.

The concept is built on clean structural lines and an open spatial flow, free of unnecessary partitions. Large glazed surfaces dissolve the boundary between interior and surroundings, so nature becomes part of every occasion, from weddings and celebrations to business gatherings and family events.

The result is an elegant venue that relies on simplicity, light and a connection to place rather than on decoration.

projects.title: Villa Dve Koracica, Kosmaj
projects.description:
Nestled in the tranquil landscape of Koraćica, right at the foothills of Mount Kosmaj, this residential project represents a perfect fusion of modern architecture and natural serenity. The estate features two independently designed, single-story villas, thoughtfully positioned to maximize both the gently sloping terrain and the sweeping views of the surrounding woodland. With a footprint that occupies just over 20% of the land, the design ensures that lush green spaces remain the true protagonist of the property.  

Both residences are defined by clean lines, flat roofs, and a warm material palette. The façades feature a sophisticated combination of decorative silicate render and ventilated Siberian larch cladding, creating an aesthetic that is both contemporary and deeply rooted in its environment. Inside, the layouts are open and light-filled, featuring expansive living zones with three-meter-high ceilings that seamlessly transition into large outdoor terraces and private swimming pools.  

Beyond their striking appearance, these homes are engineered for the future. Built using an advanced prefabricated timber-frame system, they offer exceptional thermal performance and acoustic insulation, placing them at the highest standards of energy efficiency. From the underfloor heating to the smartly integrated basement utility spaces, every detail has been crafted to provide an effortless, luxurious, and highly sustainable living experience.

‍

projects.title: Villa Duo, Divcibare
projects.description:
Nestled in the serene mountain landscape of Divčibare, this contemporary residential estate redefines alpine living. The project consists of a spacious family home and a thoughtfully designed guest house, both crafted to harmonize flawlessly with their natural surroundings. Combining the warmth of Siberian larch with the sleekness of anthracite steel, the architecture offers a modern interpretation of the traditional mountain retreat.  

The main residence is designed around natural light and open space, featuring impressive three-meter-high ceilings and a grand living area anchored by a central fireplace. It serves as a true private sanctuary, complete with a dedicated lower-level SPA and wellness zone that flows seamlessly onto an outdoor terrace. The accompanying guest house mirrors this sophisticated comfort, offering an open-plan layout, its own sauna, and a charming sleeping gallery.  

Beyond its striking aesthetics, the estate is built for ultimate comfort and sustainability. With advanced thermal insulation, underfloor heating powered by heat pumps, and integrated smart home technology, it provides a highly energy-efficient haven. This project is not just a house; it is a meticulously engineered retreat where modern luxury meets the untamed beauty of nature.

‍

projects.title: Liman 2, Ulcinj
projects.description: Located on the beautiful coast of the Adriatic Sea, at Liman 2 Beach in the charming town of Ulcinj, this modern residential-commercial project is designed to blend seamlessly with its unique terrain. The building adopts a cascading form to adapt to the complex topography, making it a standout feature in its environment.

projects.title: Apartment PB/23 MB
projects.description:
This apartment is designed with the principles of contemporary architectural minimalism in mind, focusing on functionality and maximizing space. The open-plan living area, which integrates the living room and kitchen, creates a sense of spaciousness and fluidity. This concept is ideal for modern lifestyles, allowing different functional zones to flow seamlessly into one another.
